turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like the perfect cozy desk assistant. Have you managed to get a break from grading at all today?

turns.text: I did, luckily. I made sure to take some time to head over to the gym for some weights today. It's a nice way to break up the afternoon.

turns.text: That's great! Since you fully recovered from that lower back strain, how did the weight lifting feel today? Everything feeling strong?

turns.text: Yeah, absolutely no issues at all. My back feels completely fine, so doing gym weights felt really good. I'm glad I'm back to my normal strength.

turns.text: I'm so glad to hear that. Have you been able to get back on the tennis court lately as well, or has the rainy Portland weather put a pause on that?

turns.text: We've had to move indoors for tennis because of the rain, but Grace and I still managed to play a doubles match last weekend with some friends. It's keeping us active.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Indoor courts are a lifesaver this time of year. How are things going at school? I imagine the science department is pretty busy leading up to the Thanksgiving break.

turns.text: It is! Since it's a short week, the students are definitely a bit distracted. I'm trying to keep everyone focused on their chemistry labs before we head off for the holiday.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet they're already dreaming of the holiday! It's always a challenge keeping high schoolers focused during short weeks. I hope the rest of your grading goes quickly today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I've only got a few more lab reports to look over, and then I'm calling it a day. Talk to you tomorrow!
